title: Why Sleep Matters
desc: 睡个好觉，比熬夜学习更能帮你记住东西。

vocab.ex: Sleep moves what you learned into long-term memory.
vocab.exZh: 睡眠会把学到的东西转入长期记忆。

vocab.ex: A lack of sleep changes your mood and your focus.
vocab.exZh: 缺乏睡眠会改变你的情绪和专注力。

vocab.en: the state of not having enough of something
vocab.ex: A lack of sleep also changes your mood.
vocab.exZh: 缺乏睡眠还会改变你的情绪。

vocab.en: to fix something that is damaged
vocab.ex: Your body uses sleep to repair itself.
vocab.exZh: 你的身体利用睡眠来修复自己。

vocab.ex: A simple routine can help: go to bed at the same time.
vocab.exZh: 一个简单的日常习惯就能帮上忙：在同一时间上床睡觉。

vocab.en: how you feel at a particular time
vocab.ex: Small problems feel bigger when your mood is low.
vocab.exZh: 情绪低落时，小问题会显得更大。

en: Sleep is not a waste of time; it is when your brain does some of its most important work.
During sleep, your brain moves the things you learned during the day into long-term memory.
That is why a good night of sleep can help you remember more than a long night of studying.
zh: 睡眠不是浪费时间；那是你大脑做一些最重要工作的时候。
睡眠时，你的大脑会把白天学到的东西转入长期记忆。
这就是为什么睡个好觉比熬夜学习更能帮你记住东西。

en: A lack of sleep also changes your mood and your focus the next day.
Small problems feel bigger, and it is harder to pay attention in class or at work.
Your body uses sleep to repair itself, from your muscles to your skin.
zh: 缺乏睡眠还会改变你第二天的情绪和专注力。
小问题会显得更大，在课堂或工作中也更难集中注意力。
你的身体利用睡眠来修复自己，从肌肉到皮肤都是如此。

en: A simple routine can help: go to bed at the same time, keep your room dark, and put your phone away an hour before sleep.
It may feel hard at first, but after a week your body will start to expect sleep at that hour.
Good sleep is not a luxury; it is part of staying healthy.
zh: 一个简单的日常习惯就能帮上忙：在同一时间上床睡觉，保持房间黑暗，睡前一小时把手机放下。
刚开始可能觉得难，但一周之后，你的身体就会开始在那个时间期待睡眠。
好的睡眠不是奢侈品，而是保持健康的一部分。
